verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly document an update path: `npx skills update` pulls latest changes non-destructively for the copy-mode install, and the managed/read-only bundle mode auto-updates on ship via the Claude Code marketplace plugin route (`claude plugins install mattpocock-skills`). Runtime probe confirms the install mechanism works end-to-end. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on confirmation specifically of the update command's behavior over time, and no evidence of version pinning or changelog for updates.
